V-A01.why: ruling 3: Instagram 4:5 only on the API path

before.test: Master canvas is 2160×2700 (4:5); LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads and Facebook get portrait 4:5 (Instagram may use 3:4)

V-A14.why: ruling 3: keep the house cap of 10, note the API's 2-20

before.test: Threads post has at most 10 images until Meta's limit is confirmed

V-A15.why: ruling 3: Instagram carousels at most 10 slides (Graph API); breaking it breaks the post

before.test: Instagram carousel has at most 20 slides

V-H12.why: ruling 3: 3D only on numerals; coins, phones, arrows and question marks are flat 2D

before.test: At least 1 slide per money deck carries a number with a recognizable object (coin stack, receipt, phone screen)
Each 3D object is a story metaphor (coin = cashback, numeral = the key figure, phone = the app)
Smallest text on any slide is at least 61px (11pt display)
Body and supporting text is at least 94px (17pt display)
Slide headline is at least 187px (34pt display)

V-D01.why: merged T-C07 (measure on the background plate)

before.test: Every text element is at least 4.5:1 against the worst-case background pixel under its box
Body text reaches 7:1 where the layout allows
Edges are anti-aliased: render at 2x supersampling or better, no stair-stepping at 100%
3D layer is rendered at final output resolution, not upscaled
Elements that bleed into the next slide align within 2px across the seam
Posts in a rolling 4-week window that feature a real person (founder, or a real merchant with a signed release)
Brand names spelled per owner rules ('Mastercard'; 'Visa' as an adjective, not possessive or plural)
SVPay logo is the current transparent master, with the same position and size on every slide
Motion versions have no flashes above 3 per second

SC25.why: ruling 5: copy rules for public images; merged MC-P01, MC-P02, MC-P03, MC-P05, MC-S09, which assumed USDC, bank or insurance wording could appear

before.test: Banned words are also absent from Canva slide text and image file names

SC07.why: ruling 5: merged MC-P09, which allowed the custody claim when counsel-checked

before.test: Never "SVPay never holds your money" or synonyms
All arithmetic recomputed by script (rate × ticket = dollars shown)

ALL-13.why: merged F-NI10 (news freshness on the image)

before.test: News is fresh when published
before.pass: ≤48 h old, or the post says why it matters now (max 14 days)

R-D11.why: ruling 3: add a gate, no 3D object other than a numeral; merged QB25

before.test: Only numerals in 3D: every 3D mesh is a digit 0–9. "$", "%", "?", arrows and coins are flat (HTML or 2D)

QF26.why: ruling 3: LinkedIn PDF pages stay 4:5 (V-A11); delivery check added

before.test: A 4:5 LinkedIn PDF renders without letterboxing: one test document upload per quarter
before.pass: the LinkedIn viewer shows the page with no added bars

QF01.why: ruling 3: pre-size the files; merged T-J11, F-TH01, F-NI13

before.test: Meta file is pre-sized to 1440x1800: pixel size of the file sent to Instagram, Threads and Facebook

QF29.why: ruling 3: pre-size the files; merged T-J02, QF13 (QF13's PNG rule conflicts with the JPEG ruling)

before.test: Master goes to LinkedIn and X when it fits: the file chosen for LinkedIn and X
Slide-1 headline word count
Document share of LinkedIn posts while the founder has under 5,000 followers
before.pass: ≤50% in any rolling 4 weeks; the rest are single 4:5 images

before.test: Glyph clearance (replaces the bbox-overlap logic): minimum pixel distance between adjacent glyphs within a word
before.pass: ≥ max(2 px, 0.04·h) at master and at SIM1 (scaled) †

MC-H05.why: ruling 5: savings are 'up to' with a footnote and the every-sale assumption next to the figure

before.test: A savings figure counts only card fees avoided on sales actually paid through SVPay, and the slide states the share assumption in plain words ("if all $500,000 is paid with SVPay")

MC-K01.why: ruling 5: pricing words only from approved_lines.json

before.test: "$0", "free" and "no fee" claims always name the fee type ("$0 transaction fees", "$0 cash-out fees"). Bare "free" or "no fees" fails

MC-P06.why: ruling 5: the research's 'SVPay is not a bank.' line uses a banned word

before.test: Any slide showing balances, wallets or "keep your money" claims carries "SVPay is not a bank." at ≥61px

MC-K05.why: ruling 5: offer words from the approved lines (SC21)

before.test: Sign-up offers ("$5 back", "first order up to $20 on us") state "first order only" and any end date on the image

MC-H07.why: ruling 5: plan wording from the pricing source

before.test: The "up to" footnote includes four elements: sales volume, competitor rate with its source date, the SVPay plan price assumed, and "Your savings depend on your sales and current rates."
